clips.en: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.

clips.sn: Shoka dzacho dzine makwati nenzara, dzinokandira mazai, uye dzinofamba nemakumbo adzo maviri eshure semaT-Rex.
clips.en: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.

clips.sn: Nhasi, tuzvipembenene tusingakwanise kupeta mapapiro atwo kumashure idragon fly nemayflies.
clips.en: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.

clips.sn: Mapfekero ekutanga ainyanyisa kukonzereswa netsika yeByzantine kumabvazuva.
clips.en: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.

clips.sn: Kuti unyatsoona Hong Kong zvakanaka, ibva pachitsuwa ichi uende kuKowloon waterfront irikune rimwe divi.
clips.en: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.

clips.sn: Argentina inozivikanwa nekuve nechimwe chezvikwata nevatambi vepolo vanogonesesa pasi rose.
clips.en: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.

clips.sn: Mosasaurus ndiyo yaiva mhuka yepamusoro panguva yayo, nekudaro, hapana zvayayitya kunze kwemamwe mamosasaurs.
clips.en: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.

clips.sn: Kubva pakuvambwa kweAsunción muna1537, Paraguay yakwanisa kuchengetedza hunhu nemaitiro ayo emo akawanda.
clips.en: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
